video_title: Is Tyrese Maxey a Top 5 Player in the NBA Right Now?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues for Tyrese Maxey's place in the top five
quotes.excerpt: I got to slide Tyrese Maxey somewhere in that top five. He is in the MVP conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I got to slide Tyrese Maxey somewhere in that top five. He is in the MVP conversation.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He is top ten, right with Anthony Edwards, Jayson Tatum.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, top ten, my ass. I am bumping out Nikola Jokic.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Who are you bumping out then?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I am bumping out Nikola Jokic.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins critiques Nikola Jokic's performance relative to Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: Jokic is not leading his team in points per game, Jamal Murray is.
quotes.quote: Jokic is not leading his team in points per game, Jamal Murray is. Jokic has, and in his greatness is still, but his numbers has dropped from what they were. Last time I checked, the 76ers, I am not tap dancing, I am doing the stats. 25, 11, and 9, 55 percent from the field, is Nikola Jokic. And Tyrese Maxey is 26 per game on the team that is loaded. By the way, his team has the number one seed, this should come and play. His team has the number one seed in the Eastern Conference.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the team success of the Nuggets and 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Denver is 10 and 5, Philly is 14 and 3. It is like they are brother and sister.
quotes.quote: Denver is 10 and 5, Philly is 14 and 3. It is like they are brother and sister. It is like right there. They are not twins, they could be brothers and sisters, they are not twins.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson evaluates Tyrese Maxey's All-NBA potential
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is an absolute stud. He is on pace for a possible first team all NBA.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is an absolute stud. He is on pace for a possible first team all NBA. He has got an absolute loaded squad around him. To put respect on Jokic's name, I am not saying you are disrespecting, I am saying to put respect on his name. Last season, he did something that has never been done before. This year, he is averaging a triple double and they are 10 and 5 with wins over Boston, with wins over Houston, back to back, two of the Western Conference juggernauts. So to say that Jokic is not a top five player, I think that is really, in my opinion, closer to a top two or one than he is to being outside the top five.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Luka Doncic are better than Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: I don't even think Jayson Tatum should be in the top five.
quotes.quote: I don't even think Jayson Tatum should be in the top five. Right now, if right now, here is the question that I ask the room, it is early, we are 17 games in, we will just round it off at 20. Tyrese Maxey is a top five MVP candidate right now. Tyrese Maxey is a top five MVP candidate right now.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson highlights Nikola Jokic's elite efficiency
quotes.excerpt: Jokic is 90 percent from the free throw line, 56 percent from the field, 36 percent from three.
quotes.quote: Jokic is 90 percent from the free throw line, 56 percent from the field, 36 percent from three. Efficiency at a level that we rarely, rarely ever get to see. 90 percent from a big man, that is next level. So the numbers say he is closer to one, two, and three, the numbers say that with the 10 and 5 record than being outside the top five. That is my point.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins explains why Cade Cunningham is the hub of the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: He is the centerpiece, he is the sun, the hub for the Detroit Pistons.
quotes.quote: He is the centerpiece, he is the sun, the hub for the Detroit Pistons. Jokic is the hub of the Denver Nuggets. It is hard to average 26 efficiently with guys around you, or is it hard to average 26 in the position that Cade is in?
